title: G42 orders ~$389M of Cerebras supercomputers

sources.quote: Under the Framework Agreement, we are entitled to receive an aggregate of approximately $389.0 million upon performance of purchase orders

explain: Abu Dhabi's G42 signed a framework deal in September 2023 to buy Cerebras AI supercomputers (the Condor Galaxy systems), worth about $389M. G42 became Cerebras's biggest customer by far.
